subject: Vendor onboarding: PO intake form + net terms reconciliation for Helix Data Systems
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@helixdata.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Theo Park <theo.park@helixdata.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — initial questions

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding checklist. We're excited to get live as a Redwood supplier. A couple of items from our finance team:

- We typically operate on Net 60 for new enterprise customers while credit terms are established. Can Redwood accept Net 60 for the first 90 days?
- If Redwood needs shorter terms, we could offer an early-pay discount of 1.5% if invoices are paid within 15 days.
- Our procurement team completed the vendor intake but I attached the W9 and can fill any additional PO intake fields you share.

Attaching: W9_Helix_2026.pdf

Can you confirm PO number format and whether you require the vendor intake in your portal or via the PDF form?

Thanks,
Elena
Vendor Ops — Helix Data Systems
[Attachment: W9_Helix_2026.pdf (PDF)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@helixdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — initial questions

Hi Elena,

Welcome — glad to have Helix in the pipeline. Quick answers and next steps:

1) PO intake: we prefer vendors to register in our vendor portal for automated PO routing. If you'd rather, you can return the attached Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and we will ingest it.
2) PO format: our POs look like RDF-XXXXX; finance will confirm final routing once vendor_id is created.
3) Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 45 for new suppliers, with case-by-case Net 30 for strategic partners. We do not typically start at Net 60.

That said, we can offer a phased path: start at Net 45 for the first 90 days while we onboard; if both sides are satisfied we can evaluate moving to Net 30. Regarding your early-pay discount, a 1.5% for payment within 15 days is something finance can consider if you can accept Net 45 as the base.

Action items:
- Elena: please complete the attached Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (or register in the portal) and return it.
- Marissa: can you take point on portal registration + confirm whether vendor_id can be provisioned this week?
- David: can you confirm whether finance would accept 1.5% early-pay for 15-day settlement against a Net 45 baseline?

Thanks — copying finance and procurement.

Best,
Naomi
Vendor Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks Naomi. Elena — happy to onboard Helix into the portal. Couple notes from procurement: 

- Portal registration link: https://vendorportal.redwood.com/register (please use company email).
- If you prefer the PDF, I'll ingest the Vendor_Onboarding_Form and attach required fields; prefer portal for PO automation.
- On PO routing: we can provision a vendor_id within 48 business hours once the form is submitted.

I'll start the portal invite now (Elena, expect a separate automated email). Once vendor_id is created, POs will route to accounts-payable with the Net 45 baseline. If finance approves an early-pay discount, we'll add the discount term to the supplier profile and reflect it on POs/invoices.

Let me know if you need a walk-through of the portal — happy to set up a 20-min session.

-M
Marissa Cole

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@helixdata.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — initial questions

Hi all,

Quick follow on finance side: we are comfortable with the phased plan Naomi suggested. Confirmations:

- Baseline: Net 45 for the first 90 days.
- Early-pay: we can accept a 1.5% discount for invoices settled within 15 days, provided the vendor accepts payment via standard AP rails (ACH/virtual card) and the discount is captured on the invoice.
- Net 60: we will not start at Net 60, but can re-evaluate after 90 days if Helix demonstrates consistent delivery and clean invoicing.

Next steps for Helix:
1) Register in the vendor portal (or return the PDF).
2) Verify ACH details in the portal and upload W9.
3) Confirm acceptance of Net 45 + optional 1.5% early-pay for 15-day settlement.

Once those items are in the portal, Marissa and I will finalize vendor_id and enable PO routing.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: AP_Process_FAQ.pdf]
